# Set the wedge parameters as specified:
# X min/max = 0/34 mm

# Z2 min/max = 2/8 mm

    print(f"  {prop}: {getattr(wedge, prop)}")

# Length (X), Width (Y), Height (Z) - these define the base box
# And then wedge-specific parameters

# The task specifies:
# X min/max = 0/34 mm -> Length = 34
# Y min/max = 0/22 mm -> Width = 22
# Z min/max = 0/16 mm -> Height = 16
# X2 min/max = 2/8 mm -> This seems to be the offset for the wedge face in X
# Z2 min/max = 2/8 mm -> This seems to be the offset for the wedge face in Z

# Looking at the wedge primitive, it creates a wedge shape from a rectangular box

# Now set the wedge cut parameters

# Z2 min/max = 2/8 mm means the cut starts at z=2 and ends at z=8
